features: Multi-Device Connectivity – Connect Up to 4 Devices : This wireless bluetooth mouse supports 3× Bluetooth channels and 2.4GHz wireless connectivity, letting you switch instantly between devices using a dedicated button perfect for professionals who work across multiple laptops, tablets, or desktops.

Whisper-Quiet Precision with Kailh Silent Switches : Silent Kailh switches rated for 5 million clicks deliver smooth, near-noiseless clicks built for focused work environments and distraction-free setups making this wireless mouse for laptop use a great choice for shared workspaces.

Dynamic RGB Glow with 7 Lighting Modes : Set the mood with a soft, ambient RGB underglow featuring 7 distinct lighting modes subtle, stylish, and fully expressive to complement your personal workspace aesthetic.

On-Demand DPI Switching – Up to 3200 : Switch between 5 DPI levels (up to 3200) instantly for smooth, precise control across every workflow from casual browsing to detailed photo or document editing on your laptop.

Ergonomic Sculpted Design for Long-Hour Comfort : Engineered for extended use with natural hand curves and a premium dark metal scroll wheel, this wireless mouse provides lasting comfort and a refined, professional look on any desk.

Type-C Rechargeable for Cable-Free Convenience : A built-in wireless mouse rechargeable battery with fast, modern Type-C charging keeps you working cable-free simply plug in when needed and get back to full productivity quickly.
